asset_price.decomposition: USD price 1.11931 = EUR/USD 1.12015 (FX) x token/EUR 0.99925 (peg): FX moves and token depeg are separate risks

reconciliation.rule: per adapter: markets held by that adapter vs its own reported assets (gap within tolerance); coverage = (idle counted in totalAssets + market supply credited up to each adapter's reported assets) / totalAssets; any shortfall is kept as an 'unattributed' exposure with a conservative failure model (never zero risk)

rates.source: DefiLlama hacks: 25 incidents >= $1,000,000 in last 3y on the 611 protocols with TVL >= $10,000,000 (upper bound: 266 incidents / 1282 protocols with TVL >= $1,000,000 = 6.92%/y)
